description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'ResetPasswordServiceTest' which tests the 'ResetPasswordService' in the OrangeHRM project. It includes setup, and various test methods for functionality such as email sending, password reset request handling, URL validation, and user search. The tests verify the behavior of password reset features within the authentication service of the HRM system.

classes.name: ResetPasswordServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the ResetPasswordService in OrangeHRM, covering functionalities like email retrieval, password reset request validation, email content generation, user search, password reset code generation, and URL validation.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, creates ResetPasswordService instance, loads fixture data, and sets up mocked services.

methods.name: testGetEmailService
methods.description: Verifies that getEmailService() returns an instance of EmailService.

methods.name: testResetPasswordDao
methods.description: Verifies that getResetPasswordDao() returns an instance of ResetPasswordDao.

methods.name: testHasPasswordResetRequestNotExpired
methods.description: Checks that the password reset request is not expired based on stored data.

methods.name: testExtractPasswordResetMetaData
methods.description: Tests extraction of metadata from password reset codes.

methods.name: testGenerateEmailBody
methods.description: Tests email body generation with placeholders and replacements.

methods.name: testSearchForUserRecord
methods.description: Verifies the search functionality for user records based on username input.

methods.name: testSendPasswordResetCodeEmail
methods.description: Tests sending of password reset email with mocked URL generator.

methods.name: testGeneratePasswordResetCode
methods.description: Tests generation of password reset code and metadata extraction.

methods.name: testSaveResetPassword
methods.description: Verifies saving reset password with valid and invalid credentials.

methods.name: testLogPasswordResetRequest
methods.description: Tests logging password reset requests, including mocking URL generator and service methods.

methods.name: testValidateUrl
methods.description: Verifies URL validation with various input codes.

methods.name: testValidateUser
methods.description: Checks user validation based on specific user IDs.
